fields.text: Draft an original closing-credits song. One text model writes lyrics; Mureka Generate Song sings them using the editable musical style. Music step $0.225, plus text. Listen for clear words, melody and fit to the brief; generated duration and precise musical structure can vary.

Write a short original song for the closing credits of a cozy repair-shop game. Theme: fixing a small thing makes a hard day better. Concrete details: a squeaky wheel, a borrowed wrench, a light left on for the last customer. Warm, understated and hopeful. No brand names.

fields.system: Write original singable lyrics from the brief, maximum 160 words. Plain language, concrete details, natural stresses and a short memorable chorus. Use [Verse 1], [Chorus], [Verse 2], [Chorus], [Outro] labels. Preserve the requested mood and avoid adding named brands or copyrighted lyrics. Output only section labels and lyrics.

fields.text: Gentle acoustic folk, relaxed mid-tempo, warm solo vocal, fingerpicked guitar, soft brushed percussion. Clear words and a memorable chorus; no artist imitation.
